Revision: 5abbefa5f753ee9a1920d6d2eaeede981e79eeff
License used: Apache-2.0 (upstream license files retained)
Original file SHA256 values: UPSTREAM.json

Android NativeActivity recreation:
- Keep AndroidPlatform in render-thread local storage, return owned Arc clones,
  and release that slot on the same thread when its event loop ends.
- Replace the process AndroidApp handle for each Activity. Pin a JNI local
  Activity reference before releasing a handle clone so concurrent recreation
  cannot invalidate an in-flight JNI call. Remove the unused bare Activity
  pointer accessor; callers can retain android_app() or use activity().
- Reset deferred lifecycle/readiness and chrome-cache flags for each renderer.
  Publish initialized only after the first frame, matching the readiness API.
- Keep the existing NativeActivity event/ACK protocol. No thread unsafe Send
  additions, skipped lifecycle acknowledgements, or process restart workaround.

Only src/android/jni.rs is changed from this pinned upstream snapshot.
The iOS backend and every other upstream source file are unchanged.

Bounded native input panel focus:
- Separate real Activity lifecycle from primary/embedded window focus. A child
  text panel can receive IME focus while GPUI continues rendering layout updates.
- A short transfer flag bridges the focus change. Actual panel focus loss clears
  it, and Activity Pause always overrides every focus bit.
- JNI copies only atomic focus state; no Activity lifecycle/ACK is synthesized.
